# @loom/email

> Reusable React Email components and templates, organized as atomic parts.

## Start here
- [Package exports](./package.json)
- [Atoms](./src/atoms/)
- [Molecules](./src/molecules/)
- [Organisms](./src/organisms/)
- [Templates](./src/templates/)
- [Themes](./src/themes/)
- [Tests](./tests/)

## Rules for agents
- Import only the email components needed by a message; avoid a package-wide barrel.
- Keep email markup compatible with React Email rendering and email-client constraints.
- Keep copy and branding supplied by the consuming feature. Do not add client-specific content.
- Do not import this package from the Cloudflare Worker API entry unless a measured need and runtime compatibility are documented.
